title: After the Japanese Derby: The Ines Chant

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following her heart and holding nothing back, Ines Fujin puts on a brilliant performance at the Japanese Derby and claims the title of Derby champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she can barely walk after her fierce performance, she musters the energy to head over to the stands and respond to her supporters' cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They chant her name over and over in celebration of her victory. Summoning the last of her strength, Ines Fujin thanks the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And finally, after her winning concert… she collapses.
